main.title: Interviewing people who are tired
main.lead: Research after a ten-hour shift, kindly.

items.text: The people with the most to tell you often have the least time left in the day. Plan for that, not around it.
Meet at the end of a shift, near the bus stop, with food. Twenty minutes is plenty.
A tired person’s hour is worth more than yours. Pay it in cash, on the day.
